messages.content:
Risk: Spreading disinformation
Description: Generative AI models might be used to intentionally create misleading or false information to deceive or influence a targeted audience.
Concern: Spreading disinformation might affect human's ability to make informed decisions. A model that has this potential must be properly governed.
Policy: Misinformation

Candidate ontology classes:
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#DeepfakeDisinformation: Deepfake Disinformation — Use of AI-generated synthetic media depicting individuals saying or doing things they did not, created intentionally to deceive and manipulate audiences. [found by 6/10 queries]
  Siblings: State-Sponsored Propaganda, Conspiracy Theory Promotion
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#Disinformation: Disinformation — Deliberately false information spread with malicious intent to deceive, manipulate public opinion, or cause harm to individuals, groups, or institutions. [found by 6/10 queries]
  Siblings: Financial Fraud, Manipulation, Academic Dishonesty
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#Misinformation: Misinformation — False or inaccurate information shared without malicious intent to deceive, often due to misunderstanding, carelessness, or lack of fact-checking. [found by 5/10 queries]
  Siblings: Financial Fraud, Manipulation, Academic Dishonesty
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#StateSponsoredPropaganda: State-Sponsored Propaganda — Coordinated spread of biased or false information by government actors to shape public opinion, justify policies, or undermine adversaries. [found by 4/10 queries]
  Siblings: Deepfake Disinformation, Conspiracy Theory Promotion
- https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/SEC/Funds/CollectiveInvestmentVehicles/RiskLevel: risk level — None [found by 3/10 queries]
  Siblings: moneyness, market level classifier, occurrence kind

axes.rationale: The core risk is the spread of disinformation, so this class directly represents the content being acted upon.
Deepfakes are a specific and increasingly concerning form of disinformation, representing a variation on the core risk.
